title: Hynek 1966 article on UFOs over Minot missiles
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Hynek 1966 article on UFOs over Minot missiles, about 1966 (read 1973) at Minot Air Force Base, North Dakota, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Minot Air Force Base, North Dakota

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells how his guest, the researcher Robert Hastings, came across an article in 1973 written in 1966 by the astronomer J. Allen Hynek, who then worked on Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's official UFO investigation of the 1950s and 60s. According to Michels, the article said UFOs had floated around nuclear missiles at Minot Air Force Base in North Dakota, which, if true, would mean UFOs were taking an interest in American nuclear weapons.
